description:
Why: the scope page now says defk works beside Nx (and that overlap with Nx is fine), but the only interop guidance is one sentence in docs/language.md: 'Nx.to_binary/1 of an {:f, 32}, {:s, 16}, ... tensor is the same layout.' Explorer has none at all; examples/README.md's wrapper table says 'Interop, not rewriting: zero-copy views over their packed buffers' and that an interop ticket should be filed when a workload asks. Using a kernel beside Nx or Explorer is only cheap if moving data in and out is documented and checked.

Scope (docs and tests only; defk takes no dependency on Nx or Explorer, they are test-only deps if needed):
1. Nx: Nx.to_binary/1 into a kernel and Nx.from_binary/2 back, both directions, for every defk element type that has an Nx type (f64 {:f,64}, f32 {:f,32}, i64 {:s,64}, i32 {:s,32}, i16 {:s,16}, u8 {:u,8}, u64 {:u,64}), plus the Nx types with no defk element type (f16, bf16, u16, u32, s8...) and what to do with them. Endianness (Nx binaries are native-endian; confirm). When the conversion copies: BinaryBackend (is the binary the tensor's own?) vs EXLA/EMLX (device-to-host transfer). Empty input: Nx cannot build an empty tensor (nx.ex L2057), a kernel can take <<>>.
2. Explorer: check whether Explorer.Series.to_binary/1 and from_binary/3 (or an equivalent) exist in the current version, their layout per dtype, null handling (a validity bitmap is not in the binary: what does a kernel see for nulls?), and whether the conversion copies.
3. A short guide section (docs/guides/, or a new 'Using kernels beside Nx and Explorer' guide) with a worked example each: a tensor in, a kernel loop with early exit or a data-dependent step, a tensor out.
4. Tests that pin the layouts: round-trip agreement for each type pair, so a change in Nx or Explorer layout fails here rather than in a user's app.

Done when: the guide section exists and is checked by the docs example test (or marked skip with a test that runs the same steps), round-trip tests pass for every supported type pair, the copy/no-copy facts and null handling are written down with sources, and docs/language.md's sentence links to the guide.

comments.text: Moved out of defk-djy (epic closed 2026-10-20) and deferred: owner priority of 2026-10-17 puts bounds proofs (defk-w8r.3) and call cost (defk-25s) before interop guides. Undefer when the measurement map is done or a user asks for Nx or Explorer interop.

title: Guide and tests: moving data between Nx/Explorer and kernels
